verses.original: εἶ Διὸ ἀναπολόγητος ὦ ἄνθρωπε πᾶς ὁ κρίνων γὰρ ἐν ᾧ κρίνεις τὸν ἕτερον κατακρίνεις σεαυτὸν γὰρ ὁ κρίνων πράσσεις τὰ αὐτὰ
verses.transliteration: ei Dio anapologētos ō anthrōpe pas ho krinōn gar en hō krineis ton heteron katakrineis seauton gar ho krinōn prasseis ta auta
verses.literal: You therefore have no excuse - [you] who - pass judgment [on another] For on whatever grounds you judge the other you are condemning yourself because [you who] pass judgment do the same things

verses.original: δὲ οἴδαμεν ὅτι τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ κρίμα ἐπὶ τοὺς πράσσοντας τὰ τοιαῦτα ἐστιν κατὰ ἀλήθειαν
verses.transliteration: de oidamen hoti to tou Theou krima epi tous prassontas ta toiauta estin kata alētheian
verses.literal: And we know that - - God’s judgment against those who do - such things is based on truth

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ὦ ἄνθρωπε κρίνων τοὺς τὰ καὶ ποιῶν αὐτά τοιαῦτα πράσσοντας λογίζῃ τοῦτο ὅτι σὺ ἐκφεύξῃ τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ κρίμα
verses.transliteration: de ho ō anthrōpe krinōn tous ta kai poiōn auta toiauta prassontas logizē touto hoti sy ekpheuxē to tou Theou krima
verses.literal: [So when] [you] O man pass judgment on [others] . . . yet do - the same things . . . do you think - - you will escape - - God’s judgment

verses.original: ἢ καταφρονεῖς τοῦ πλούτου τῆς αὐτοῦ χρηστότητος καὶ τῆς ἀνοχῆς καὶ τῆς μακροθυμίας ἀγνοῶν ὅτι τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ χρηστὸν ἄγει σε εἰς μετάνοιάν
verses.transliteration: ē kataphroneis tou ploutou tēs autou chrēstotētos kai tēs anochēs kai tēs makrothymias agnoōn hoti to tou Theou chrēston agei se eis metanoian
verses.literal: Or do you disregard the riches of His kindness - - tolerance and - patience not realizing that - - God’s kindness leads you to repentance

verses.original: δὲ Κατὰ σου τὴν σκληρότητά καὶ ἀμετανόητον καρδίαν θησαυρίζεις ὀργὴν σεαυτῷ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς καὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ δικαιοκρισίας ἀποκαλύψεως
verses.transliteration: de Kata sou tēn sklērotēta kai ametanoēton kardian thēsaurizeis orgēn seautō en hēmera orgēs kai tou Theou dikaiokrisias apokalypseōs
verses.literal: But because of your - hard and unrepentant heart you are storing up wrath against yourself for [the] day of wrath [when] - God’s righteous judgment will be revealed

verses.original: ὃς Ἀποδώσει ἑκάστῳ κατὰ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα
verses.transliteration: hos Apodōsei hekastō kata autou ta erga
verses.literal: [God] will repay each one according to his - deeds

verses.original: τοῖς μὲν καθ’ ὑπομονὴν ἔργου ἀγαθοῦ ζητοῦσιν δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν αἰώνιον ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: tois men kath’ hypomonēn ergou agathou zētousin doxan kai timēn kai aphtharsian aiōnion zōēn
verses.literal: To those who - by perseverance in doing good seek glory - honor and immortality [He will give] eternal life

verses.original: δὲ τοῖς ἐξ ἐριθείας καὶ ἀπειθοῦσι τῇ ἀληθείᾳ δὲ πειθομένοις τῇ ἀδικίᾳ ὀργὴ καὶ θυμός
verses.transliteration: de tois ex eritheias kai apeithousi tē alētheia de peithomenois tē adikia orgē kai thymos
verses.literal: But for those who vvv [are] self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow - wickedness [there will be] wrath and anger

verses.original: θλῖψις καὶ στενοχωρία ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ἀνθρώπου ψυχὴν τοῦ κατεργαζομένου τὸ κακόν τε πρῶτον Ἰουδαίου καὶ Ἕλληνος
verses.transliteration: thlipsis kai stenochōria epi pasan anthrōpou psychēn tou katergazomenou to kakon te prōton Ioudaiou kai Hellēnos
verses.literal: [There will be] trouble and distress for every human being who does - evil - first for the Jew then for the Greek

verses.original: δὲ δόξα καὶ τιμὴ καὶ εἰρήνη παντὶ τῷ ἐργαζομένῳ τὸ ἀγαθόν τε Ἰουδαίῳ πρῶτον καὶ Ἕλληνι
verses.transliteration: de doxa kai timē kai eirēnē panti tō ergazomenō to agathon te Ioudaiō prōton kai Hellēni
verses.literal: but glory - honor and peace for everyone who does - good - first for the Jew then for the Greek

verses.original: γάρ παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ ἐστιν οὐ προσωπολημψία
verses.transliteration: gar para tō Theō estin ou prosōpolēmpsia
verses.literal: For - - God does not show . . . favoritism

verses.original: γὰρ Ὅσοι ἥμαρτον ἀνόμως καὶ ἀπολοῦνται ἀνόμως καὶ ὅσοι ἥμαρτον ἐν νόμῳ κριθήσονται διὰ νόμου
verses.transliteration: gar Hosoi hēmarton anomōs kai apolountai anomōs kai hosoi hēmarton en nomō krithēsontai dia nomou
verses.literal: - All who sin apart from the law vvv will also perish apart from the law and all who sin under [the] law will be judged by [the] law

verses.original: γὰρ οὐ οἱ ἀκροαταὶ νόμου δίκαιοι παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ ἀλλ’ οἱ ποιηταὶ νόμου δικαιωθήσονται
verses.transliteration: gar ou hoi akroatai nomou dikaioi para tō Theō all’ hoi poiētai nomou dikaiōthēsontai
verses.literal: For [it is] not the hearers of [the] law [who are] righteous before - God but [it is] the doers of [the] law [who] will be declared righteous

verses.original: γὰρ Ὅταν ἔθνη τὰ μὴ ἔχοντα νόμον ποιῶσιν φύσει τὰ τοῦ νόμου εἰσιν νόμος ἑαυτοῖς οὗτοι μὴ ἔχοντες νόμον
verses.transliteration: gar Hotan ethnē ta mē echonta nomon poiōsin physei ta tou nomou eisin nomos heautois houtoi mē echontes nomon
verses.literal: Indeed when Gentiles who vvv do not have [the] law do by nature what the law [requires] they are a law to themselves [even though] they vvv do not have [the] law

verses.original: οἵτινες ἐνδείκνυνται τὸ ἔργον τοῦ νόμου γραπτὸν ἐν αὐτῶν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν τῆς συνειδήσεως καὶ συμμαρτυρούσης ἀλλήλων τῶν λογισμῶν μεταξὺ κατηγορούντων ἢ καὶ ἀπολογουμένων
verses.transliteration: hoitines endeiknyntai to ergon tou nomou grapton en autōn tais kardiais autōn tēs syneidēseōs kai symmartyrousēs allēlōn tōn logismōn metaxy katēgorountōn ē kai apologoumenōn
verses.literal: [So] they show [that] the work of the law is written on their - hearts their - consciences also bearing witness [and] their - thoughts either accusing or - defending [them]

verses.original: ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ὅτε ὁ Θεὸς κρίνει τῶν ἀνθρώπων τὰ κρυπτὰ διὰ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ κατὰ μου τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν
verses.transliteration: en hē hēmera hote ho Theos krinei tōn anthrōpōn ta krypta dia Christou Iēsou kata mou to euangelion
verses.literal: on the day when - God will judge - men’s - secrets through Christ Jesus as proclaimed by my - gospel

verses.original: δὲ σὺ Εἰ ἐπονομάζῃ Ἰουδαῖος καὶ ἐπαναπαύῃ νόμῳ καὶ καυχᾶσαι ἐν Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: de sy Ei eponomazē Ioudaios kai epanapauē nomō kai kauchasai en Theō
verses.literal: Now you if you call [yourself] a Jew [if you] rely on [the] law and boast in God

verses.original: καὶ γινώσκεις τὸ θέλημα καὶ δοκιμάζεις τὰ διαφέροντα κατηχούμενος ἐκ τοῦ νόμου
verses.transliteration: kai ginōskeis to thelēma kai dokimazeis ta diapheronta katēchoumenos ek tou nomou
verses.literal: [if you] know [His] will and approve of what is superior because you are instructed by the law

verses.original: τε πέποιθάς σεαυτὸν εἶναι ὁδηγὸν τυφλῶν φῶς τῶν ἐν σκότει
verses.transliteration: te pepoithas seauton einai hodēgon typhlōn phōs tōn en skotei
verses.literal: [if you] are convinced [that] you are a guide for [the] blind a light for those in darkness

verses.original: παιδευτὴν ἀφρόνων διδάσκαλον νηπίων ἔχοντα ἐν τῷ νόμῳ τὴν μόρφωσιν τῆς γνώσεως καὶ τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: paideutēn aphronōn didaskalon nēpiōn echonta en tō nomō tēn morphōsin tēs gnōseōs kai tēs alētheias
verses.literal: an instructor of [the] foolish a teacher of infants [because] you have in the law the embodiment - of knowledge and - truth

verses.original: οὖν ὁ διδάσκων ἕτερον οὐ διδάσκεις σεαυτὸν ὁ κηρύσσων μὴ κλέπτειν κλέπτεις
verses.transliteration: oun ho didaskōn heteron ou didaskeis seauton ho kēryssōn mē kleptein klepteis
verses.literal: {you,} then who teach others vvv do you not teach yourself You who preach against stealing do you steal

verses.original: ὁ λέγων μὴ μοιχεύειν μοιχεύεις ὁ βδελυσσόμενος τὰ εἴδωλα ἱεροσυλεῖς
verses.transliteration: ho legōn mē moicheuein moicheueis ho bdelyssomenos ta eidōla hierosyleis
verses.literal: You who forbid . . . adultery do you commit adultery You who abhor - idols do you rob temples

verses.original: ὃς καυχᾶσαι ἐν νόμῳ ἀτιμάζεις τὸν Θεὸν διὰ τῆς παραβάσεως τοῦ νόμου
verses.transliteration: hos kauchasai en nomō atimazeis ton Theon dia tēs parabaseōs tou nomou
verses.literal: You who boast in [the] law do you dishonor - God by - breaking the law

verses.original: γὰρ καθὼς γέγραπται τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ Ὄνομα βλασφημεῖται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν δι’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: gar kathōs gegraptai to tou Theou Onoma blasphēmeitai en tois ethnesin di’ hymas
verses.literal: - As it is written - vvv God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you

verses.original: μὲν γὰρ Περιτομὴ ὠφελεῖ ἐὰν πράσσῃς νόμον δὲ ἐὰν ᾖς παραβάτης νόμου σου ἡ περιτομή γέγονεν ἀκροβυστία
verses.transliteration: men gar Peritomē ōphelei ean prassēs nomon de ean ēs parabatēs nomou sou hē peritomē gegonen akrobystia
verses.literal: - - Circumcision has value if you observe [the] law but if you break [the] law your - circumcision has become uncircumcision

verses.original: οὖν ἐὰν ἡ ἀκροβυστία φυλάσσῃ τὰ δικαιώματα τοῦ νόμου οὐχ αὐτοῦ ἡ ἀκροβυστία λογισθήσεται εἰς περιτομὴν
verses.transliteration: oun ean hē akrobystia phylassē ta dikaiōmata tou nomou ouch autou hē akrobystia logisthēsetai eis peritomēn
verses.literal: - If - a man who is not circumcised keeps the requirements of the law {will} not his - uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision

verses.original: καὶ ἡ ἐκ φύσεως ἀκροβυστία τελοῦσα τὸν νόμον κρινεῖ σὲ τὸν διὰ γράμματος καὶ περιτομῆς παραβάτην νόμου
verses.transliteration: kai hē ek physeōs akrobystia telousa ton nomon krinei se ton dia grammatos kai peritomēs parabatēn nomou
verses.literal: - The [one who is] vvv physically uncircumcised [yet] keeps the law will condemn you who [even though you have] [the] written code and circumcision [are] a lawbreaker . . .

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ ἐστιν Οὐ Ἰουδαῖός ἐν τῷ φανερῷ οὐδὲ περιτομή ἡ ἐν τῷ φανερῷ ἐν σαρκὶ
verses.transliteration: gar ho estin Ou Ioudaios en tō phanerō oude peritomē hē en tō phanerō en sarki
verses.literal: - A [man] is not a Jew [ because he is one ] - outwardly nor [is] circumcision - vvv vvv [ only ] outward [and] physical

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὁ Ἰουδαῖος ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ καὶ περιτομὴ καρδίας ἐν πνεύματι οὐ γράμματι οὗ ὁ ἔπαινος οὐκ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἀλλ’ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: all’ ho Ioudaios en tō kryptō kai peritomē kardias en pneumati ou grammati hou ho epainos ouk ex anthrōpōn all’ ek tou Theou
verses.literal: No a man [is] a Jew [ because he is one ] - inwardly and circumcision [is a matter] of the heart by [the] Spirit not by the written code [Such a man’s] - praise [does] not [come] from men but from - God
